Resolves #21741

Preserves `Neo.board.Card`'s 3px left `--neo-board-card-accent` stripe across `:hover`, `.neo-selected`, and `.neo-selected:hover`, adds a pointer-scoped (`@media (hover: hover)`) 1px outer selection ring (`box-shadow`) on `.neo-selected:hover` in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` using existing theme tokens (preserving WCAG card-text contrast across all five shipped themes without adding theme tokens), and removes the local `.triage-board .neo-board-card.neo-selected` workaround from `examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css`.

- **Intake & prescription check (`self-authored-carve`):** Drift probe since `2026-11-21T04:53:49Z` confirmed `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` and `resources/css/theme-*/board/Container.css` were untouched on `origin/dev`, while `#21734` landed `examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css`. `Prescription checked: resources/css/src/board/Card.css — owns the concern` (`src/board/Card.mjs` writes `--neo-board-card-accent` on `me.style`; `Card.css` owns border and `box-shadow` state transitions over the existing theme tokens).

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium E2E across all 5 themes + whole-page 1440×900 before/after dark and light frames) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-4).

Micro-review eligible: config-leaf — scoped CSS border/`box-shadow` state fix in `Card.css`, removal of 1 redundant example rule, and 1 multi-theme E2E regression test.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs` (`colored cards retain their left accent across rest, hover, selection and selected-hover...`) asserts `S1` (`#e5484d` / `rgb(229, 72, 77)`) `borderLeftColor` across rest, `:hover`, `.neo-selected`, and `.neo-selected:hover` in all five shipped themes (`neo-dark`, `neo-light`, `light`, `dark`, `cyberpunk`). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/board/MultiSelect.spec.mjs` asserts `S4` (`color: null`) `borderLeftColor === borderTopColor` across rest, `:hover`, and `.neo-selected`, with `:hover` and `.neo-selected` updating all four borders across all five themes. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered + visual frames below: `MultiSelect.spec.mjs` asserts hovered `.neo-selected` card `1043` renders a distinct `boxShadow` from unhovered `.neo-selected` neighbour `1042` while preserving WCAG AA title (`>= 4.5:1`) and muted-text contrast across all five themes; whole-page `1440×900` frames in `neo-dark`, `neo-light`, and `dark` embedded under `## Test Evidence`. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `.triage-board .neo-board-card.neo-selected` `border-left-color` override deleted from `resources/css/src/examples/board/multiSelect/Viewport.css`; `MultiSelect.spec.mjs` passes with the native `Card.css` rule alone. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive — uses the ticket's `box-shadow` ring option on `.neo-selected:hover` (scoped to `@media (hover: hover)`) instead of a new per-theme background token so text contrast is unchanged across all five themes.

Frame critique: Checked whole-page `1440×900` frames across `neo-dark`, `neo-light`, and `dark`: in the `before` pairs, hovering `1041` erases its 3px S2 amber left stripe into the grey hover border and hovering selected `1043` looks identical to `1042`/`1044`; in the `after` frames, `1041` keeps its 3px amber stripe on hover, `1042..1045` keep their severity stripes without `Viewport.css`'s local override, uncolored `S4` `1046` paints all four borders in the selected accent, and hovered `1043` gains a crisp outer 1px selection ring (doubling its selection frame to 2px while keeping its 3px S1 crimson inner stripe and full text contrast intact across all themes).
